subject: Logo & Testimonial approval tied to discount
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@brightlytics.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partnership publicity & possible discount

Hi Rishi,

Really enjoyed the demo today — Brightlytics is excited about Redwood’s latency and cost story. Our VP of Product asked if we can feature Redwood in our partner section and include a short testimonial (2 sentences) and use of the Redwood logo on our website and a joint blog post.

In return, we're hoping you can offer a commercial concession on year-one list pricing (we're targeting a 25% reduction). Is that something your team would consider if we provide the testimonial and prominence in our marketing?

If helpful, I can loop in our legal team to provide standard partner language.

Best,
Olivia
Senior Partnerships Manager
Brightlytics

[Attachment: Brightlytics_Marketing_Plan.pdf (reference)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@brightlytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership publicity & possible discount

Thanks Olivia — great to meet you earlier. We can consider a concession tied to an approved testimonial and logo use. My initial thinking: 25% off year-one commit in exchange for a short on-brand quote, logo use on partner page & one joint blog. Redwood must retain final approval over quote text and logo usage.

I'll need to confirm with my manager and legal on the publicity terms (duration, edit rights). If you can share the customer-friendly language/legal snippet, that will speed things up.

I'll send a redline of the MSA and a proposed SOW (attached) once we agree the scope.

Rishi
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SOW_draft_v1.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-01T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Partnership publicity & possible discount — approval needed (redlines attached)

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Olivia's ask. Key non-standard items from Brightlytics' legal:
- Perpetual logo license (they want to keep logo on site indefinitely).
- Right to slightly edit quote for length/SEO.
- Use of logo in paid marketing (social ads).

Commercial ask: 25% first-year discount and a two-year commit.

My recommendation: we can offer up to 20% discount and publicity rights capped to 12–18 months, no edits to the testimonial without our approval, and prohibit use in paid ads without separate permission. Legal would need to sign off.

Attached are my proposed redlines to the publicity clause. Need an approver for an exception to our standard 12-month partner publicity window, and permission to allow logo in limited co-marketing placements.

Laura
Account Executive

[Attachment: proposed-redlines.docx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Partnership publicity & possible discount — approval needed (redlines attached)

Thanks Laura — quick guidance:

1) Commercial concession: approve up to 20% off for year one on a 12-month minimum commit (not 2 years) — rationale: preserve ARPU and set precedent.
2) Publicity terms: limit logo/testimonial usage to 18 months maximum; require written approval on any edits to the quote; absolutely no paid-ad usage without explicit exec/legal signoff.
3) Legal: must sign off on redlines (especially perpetual language). If Brightlytics insists on perpetual or paid-ad use, deny and offer a 12-month extended term as compromise.

Provisionally approved subject to: legal clearance and final sign-off from Vivek on the commercial concession (cc'd). Rishi, please prepare the redlined MSA and a DocuSign-ready SOW reflecting 20% and the publicity constraints. Attach the Logo Guidelines for clarity.

Marissa
Director, Sales Operations

- Commercial: 20% off year-one list pricing on the committed seats specified in the attached SOW (one-year minimum).
- Publicity: Brightlytics may use the Redwood logo on your partner page and a joint blog post for up to 18 months. Redwood must approve the final testimonial text prior to publication. No use of the Redwood logo in paid advertising without separate written permission from Redwood.

If that aligns, I've attached a redlined MSA and a DocuSign link for the SOW. Please review and return the signed SOW.
